article_text:
Netflix has bought a raft of films and series from Brazilian powerhouse Globo including Walter Salles ’ Oscar-winning movie I’m Still Here .

The U.S. streamer’s agreement with Globo fare is the largest ever programming deal between the two. Netflix has acquired a package of fourteen movies, a trio of telenovelas and a TV series.

The deal for I’m Still Here is just for Brazil . Elsewhere, Netflix has taken global rights to titles including Vitória , directed by Andrucha Waddington and starring the Academy Award nominee Fernanda Montenegro.

Related Stories

Ju Ji-hoon & Choo Young-woo Return To 'The Trauma Code: Heroes On Call' With Seasons 2 & 3 In Production At Netflix

Curtain Up: 'La Bola Negra' Shines As Netflix Shares Grosses In Historic First -- Specialty Box Office

Another Brazil-only rights deal is for comedy series Vai Que Cola , created by Leandro Soares and directed by João Fonseca and Regis Faria. Netflix has acquired seven seasons of the show.

Watch on Deadline

The telenovela selection includes India – A Love Story . Created by Glória Perez and directed by Marcos Schechtman, it won the 2009 International Emmy for Best Telenovela. Specifically, Netflix has it for the U.S. and Latin America.

The titles will drop on Netflix from mid-2027.

“For decades, we have been dedicated to sharing the richness of our culture with the world,” said Pedro Garcia, Globo’s Director of Rights. “By combining that experience with Netflix’s global scale, we take another step toward bringing Brazilian creativity to new audiences, expanding the presence and strengthening the recognition of Brazilian film and television abroad.”

The agreement is a big sales story for Globo. Meanwhile, the Brazilian media giant has also been in buying mode. It has acquired game show The Perfect Line from Paramount Global Content Distribution.

The series bowed on GSN in the U.S. In Brazil, the local version will feature as a segment on Globo’s Saturday afternoon entertainment show Caldeirão com Mion .

article_text:
Founded in 2018 in partnership with the French Ministry of Culture, the Elles × Paris Photo program highlights the work of women artists and their role in the history and current landscape of photography and images. The program has helped raise the representation of women artists at the fair from 20% to 38%.

For this new edition, Paris Photo has entrusted the curation of the program to Aldeide Delgado. On the occasion of the Bicentennial of Photography, she presents An Oceanic Beginning , a selection that returns to the material conditions at the origin of the photographic image and takes the ocean as a framework for reflection. By putting historical and contemporary practices in dialogue, the program envisions a history of photography without a fixed center, made up of interconnected narratives, some of which are handed down while others remain invisible.

“On the occasion of the Bicentennial of Photography, An Oceanic Beginning looks at the resources and conditions necessary for the creation of photographs. The sea becomes the starting point for a reflection on how the history of photography can be told.” — Aldeide Delgado

Marked on the map handed out at the entrance and also available online and in a dedicated publication, the program offers a guiding thread for exploring the fair. It continues throughout the year with a series of video and written interviews, shared on the Paris Photo website, social media and YouTube channel.

About the Curator

Aldeide Delgado is an art historian, curator and founder of WOPHA (Women Photographers International Archive), an institution dedicated to promoting women and non-binary artists in the history of photography.

Her research draws in particular on feminist and decolonial approaches to broaden the narratives of the history of photography.

Daily Newsletter

The “Renegade Housewife” of Pop Art

Stories from a pioneering journalist and art worker, John Yau on Valerio Adami, and books of warp and weft for your reading list.

At age 98, Joan Kron has lived many lives. She invented plastic surgery journalism, helped Andy Warhol make his first perfume, hosted the Velvet Underground’s first Philly concert, and commissioned Roy Lichtenstein’s “Super Sunset Billboard.”

That 1967 artwork, a remake of which is on view in the late Pop artist’s exhibition at the Whitney, is one of countless projects she has wrangled into being from behind the scenes. In an exclusive interview today, the indefatigable Kron regales reporter Isabella Segalovich with a slice of those riotous stories, with more to come in her memoir titled The Renegade Housewives of Pop Art — I’ll be first in line at the bookstore.

Also today: WPA-era murals by Black artists in Harlem are finally restored, the art world descends on a champagne-soaked Frieze London, we recommend books on the rich histories of textile art, and critic John Yau finds echoes of Pop art in the paintings of Valerio Adami.

—Lakshmi Rivera Amin, associate editor

Danh Vo and Sandra Mujinga are selected for Met Museum commissions, a new leader is named for the Armenian Museum of America, Bernie Sanders weighs in on the AI art debate, and more in Art Movements .

title_original: Reimagining Liberation: Brandon Gercara Between Maloya and Voguing
editorial_title_zh: 重新想象解放：Brandon Gercara 如何让 Maloya 与 Voguing 相遇
editorial_excerpt_zh: 留尼汪艺术家 Brandon Gercara 在法国诺瓦谢尔的 La Ferme du Buisson 展出《Destin Vogoya》。展览将当地的 Maloya 音乐传统与 Voguing 舞结合，通过表演、摄影等媒介探讨酷儿身份、文化记忆与解放的可能。
editorial_blocks_json: [{"type": "heading", "text": "在法国诺瓦谢尔的 La Ferme du Buisson 艺术中心，留尼汪艺术家 Brandon Gercara 的展览《Destin Vogoya》通过表演、视觉艺术和想象性叙事，让酷儿表达、去殖民思想与文化传统展开对话。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artafricamagazine.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/still-2026-03-17-173703_1-107-2-1030x579.webp", "alt": "", "caption": "", "credit": "ART AFRICA", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "传承下来的传统，如何成为争取解放的工具？在《Destin Vogoya》中，留尼汪艺术家 Brandon Gercara 探索酷儿身份、文化记忆与抵抗之间的交汇，以艺术实验挑战既有的权力结构。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "这是 Gercara 首次在当代艺术中心举办个展。展览呈现虚构世界 Majik Kwir 的新篇章，故事围绕来自留尼汪的七位 LGBTQIA+ 主角展开。展览的核心是 vogoya：一种将 Maloya 与 Voguing 融合的形式。前者是一种根植于留尼汪抵抗历史的音乐传统，后者则是与黑人及拉美裔酷儿舞厅文化密切相关的舞蹈。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Gercara 的创作横跨表演、摄影、录像、装置、素描与绘画，探究文化实践如何通过重新诠释，为不同的身份认同和集体表达开辟空间。这种跨媒介的创作方式借鉴去殖民女性主义、交叉性和克里奥尔化思想，把艺术实践视为质疑主流社会叙事的途径。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "展览之外，Gercara 也通过支持留尼汪 LGBTQIA+ 社群的 Requeer 项目开展社会行动，推动社群获得更多公共可见性，并促进文化交流。《Destin Vogoya》邀请观众思考：传统、想象力与集体创造，如何为归属感和解放带来新的可能。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "展览在法国诺瓦谢尔的 La Ferme du Buisson 举行，展期至2027年1月24日。", "links": [{"text": "La Ferme du Buisson", "url": "https://www.lafermedubuisson.com/fr/brandon-gercara"}], "translated": true}]

article_text:
At La Ferme du Buisson in Noisiel, France, Réunionese artist Brandon Gercara’s ‘Destin Vogoya’ brings queer expression, decolonial thought and cultural traditions into dialogue through performance, visual art and speculative storytelling.

How can inherited traditions become instruments of liberation? In ‘Destin Vogoya’, Réunionese artist Brandon Gercara explores the intersections of queer identity, cultural memory and resistance, challenging established structures of power through artistic experimentation.

Marking Gercara’s first solo exhibition at a contemporary art centre, the presentation introduces a new chapter of Majik Kwir , a fictional universe following seven LGBTQIA+ protagonists from Réunion. Central to the exhibition is vogoya, a hybrid form bringing together maloya, a musical tradition rooted in Réunion’s history of resistance, and voguing, a dance form associated with Black and Latin American queer ballroom culture.

Working across performance, photography, video, installation, drawing and painting, Gercara examines how cultural practices can be reinterpreted to create spaces for alternative identities and collective expression. Their multidisciplinary approach draws on decolonial feminism, intersectionality and creolisation, positioning artistic practice as a means of questioning dominant social narratives.

Beyond the exhibition, Gercara’s activism through Requeer, an initiative supporting LGBTQIA+ communities in Réunion, reflects their commitment to visibility and cultural exchange. ‘Destin Vogoya’ invites audiences to consider how tradition, imagination and collective creativity can generate new possibilities for belonging and emancipation.

This exhibition is on view at La Ferme du Buisson , Noisiel, France, until 24 January 2027.

article_text:
Morgan Neville has made documentaries about some of the most influential cultural figures in recent history, from Brian Wilson and Keith Richards to Fred Rogers and Lorne Michaels . But there’s no challenge quite like a Beatle.

His latest film , “Man on the Run,” focuses on Paul McCartney ‘s decade following the end of The Beatles. The documentary captures his move to rural Scotland, the formation of his second major band Wings, and the recording of seminal albums like “McCartney” and “Ram.” It captures McCartney’s solo career with the same gravitas as Peter Jackson’s “Get Back,” shining light on an era of music that is often dismissed when compared to his earlier masterpieces.

At IndieWire’s Art of the Doc event on Monday, October 19, Neville sat down with IndieWire editor-in-chief Brent Lang to discuss bringing the Beatle’s story to the big screen. He explained that, despite there being so many recent documentaries about The Beatles, McCartney’s Wings era offered an untold story that could shine new light on one of the greatest songwriters of all time.

“I got a call, I met with him, and I told him this film ends the day The Beatles broke up and it ends the day John Lennon dies,” Neville said of the project’s origins.

The director went on to explain that the McCartney we see for much of the film was scarred by the aftermath of his early fame and the acrimonious breakup of his band. His retreat to pastoral family life was a necessary step in reconnecting with his own musical talents.

“There was some PTSD that all of them had from going through being a Beatle. They just didn’t ever have to grow up … in certain ways they never had to deal with reality,” he said. “People were angry, and that trauma turned into anger, like ‘Why can’t you guys just get back together?’ and blaming everybody. Linda’s idea was to go off to this tiny farmhouse to the middle of nowhere in Scotland. Which sounded a little insane, but probably was the sanest decision they ever made.”

Watch the complete conversation with Neville in the video above.

National Geographic Documentary Films, part of a joint venture between The Walt Disney Company and the National Geographic Society, is committed to bringing the world premium, feature documentaries that cover timely, provocative and globally relevant stories from the very best documentary filmmakers. Its award-winning and critically acclaimed films reach 300 million people worldwide in 180 countries and 33 languages across the global National Geographic channels and direct-to-consumer platforms Disney+ and Hulu.

Recent films include the Emmy-nominated winner of the IDA Award for Best Feature “The Tale of Silyan;” Oscar® and Peabody nominee “Sugarcane;” Oscar-nominated and Peabody Award winner “Bobi Wine: The People’s President;” Emmy Award winner “Lost In The Jungle;” Oscar- and BAFTA-nominated “Fire of Love;” Emmy and Peabody Award winner “The Territory;” BAFTA nominees “The Rescue” and “Becoming Cousteau;” and Oscar- and BAFTA winner “Free Solo.” For more information visit films.nationalgeographic.com , or find us on Facebook , Twitter , Instagram , and YouTube .

写真家・中島大輔が、18年ぶりとなる写真集『some, same それぞれ、おなじ』を2026年11月22日（日）に刊行する。20日（金）までプレオーダーを受け付けている。また、これを記念した個展「some, same」が、12月4日（金）から20日（日）まで、東京・六本木のPost-Fakeで開催される。

1983年大阪生まれの中島は、2007年にキヤノン写真新世紀準グランプリを受賞。翌2008年に写真集『each other』（青幻舎）を発表して以来、身体やセクシュアリティを題材とした作品を制作してきた。

新作『some, same』では、SNSを通じて声をかけた男性たちの身体を撮影。インターネット上に公開された写真や動画、テキストの断片を手がかりに被写体と向き合い、フレーミングやアングル、クローズアップによって個人の背景や来歴を画面から取り除いていく。

「他者は、写っていない部分を無意識に補完する」と語る中島。写真に写された身体の断片を通して、見る側が何を想像し、何を読み取ろうとするのか。写真が現実を完全には捉えられないという性質から、視覚と認識の関係を問い直す。

写真集には、美術評論家・清水穣による同等性と愛をめぐる論考を収録。アートディレクションとデザインは坂脇慶が担当した。208ページ、布クロス装のハードカバーで、函入りの仕様。セルフパブリッシングによる500部限定で刊行される。9900円（六切プリント付き限定版55000円、全40セット）。

個展では、写真集に収録された作品から発色現像方式によるプリント10点を展示し、会場で写真集も販売する。

中島大輔 個展「some, same」

14:00〜19:00（土・日曜日は12:00から）

article_text:
“Obsession” star Inde Navarrette had quite the busy weekend, going from the Academy Museum Gala on Saturday to the Newport Beach Film Festival on Sunday.

Navarrette attended the festival, which runs until Thursday in Newport Beach, as one of Variety ’s 10 Actors to Watch, who were celebrated during the festival’s Honor Brunch.

While speaking with Variety’s Marc Malkin at the festival’s carpet, Navarrette said attending the gala was “amazing.” “I mean, you’re just overwhelmed and kind of drowning in everybody that you have looked up to, possibly ever, and it’s just so lovely meeting people and the reception that ‘Obsession’ has been getting… I’m just so honored to go and be with the members of the Academy and just get an inside scoop on what that magnificent world is like.”

Popular on Variety

Related Stories

'The Pitt' And 'All Her Fault' Among the Winners of Inaugural Easterseals Disability Arts & Culture Awards

Jessica Lange and Pamela Anderson were two of the actresses Navarrette was excited to see Saturday night. “I spoke to Jessica Lange, who is an icon,” she said. “[And] the way that Pamela carries herself with such grace and honesty and just pure creativity and love is just exactly who I want to be.”

And Navarrette’s schedule isn’t slowing down just yet — she’s set to host this year’s “Saturday Night Live” Halloween episode with musical guest Gracie Abrams.

“I literally I feel like I snuck in,” joked the actress. “I’m super excited to keep everything under wraps because I really truly want to make this super fun for the audience. And what I love is when I don’t know anything. So I’m really excited to be working with the writers.”

Also on the horizon is the MCU’s forthcoming “X-Men” film, in which she’ll play Rogue. Navarrette told Malkin she hasn’t corresponded directly with Anna Paquin, who originated the role, but feels “the correspondence started when I was younger, when I really fell in love with the ‘X-Men’ movies in the first place.”

On the topic of stunt training for the superhero film, Navarrette said it’s a good excuse to get herself in the gym. “I’ve always wanted to take part in that sort of a thing,” she said. “I think it’s also a really good excuse to get in the gym. I’m the laziest person, and I am very excited to get up and move my body.”

NOTICIAS

Elizabeth Olsen define a WandaVision como un «viaje salvaje»

Antonio G. Spíndola

Wanda Maximoff también acompañará próximamente al Hechicero Supremo en Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness.

Entres las futuras series de Marvel que llegarán a la plataforma Disney+ se encuentran aquella que contará con el dúo Bruja Escarlata y Visión. El trágico romance del MCU podría aspirar a un alternativo e inexplicable final feliz, como anticipa el primer póster . No obstante, algo inquietante prevalece en aquella idílica imagen. No descartemos que WandaVision constituya (más bien) una aventura alocada, una posibilidad que recientemente señaló la actriz Elizabeth Olsen .

En entrevista para Entertainment Weekly , la intérprete de la poderosa mutante habló sobre las ansias que le genera explorar nuevas facetas de su personaje, con un mayor apego a las historietas.

«A partir de Era de Ultrón , las cosas que me encantaron de Scarlet Witch son cosas que vamos a explorar ahora. Estoy muy nerviosa y emocionada por eso en todas las formas divertidas. Pero creo que finalmente podremos recorrer algunos caminos de los cómics, que son favoritos, y explorar. Será un viaje salvaje ».

Durante la misma sesión de preguntas, el actor Paul Bettany (Visión) recalcó la oportunidad que les brinda la serie para profundizar en ambos personajes, y recalcó también la locura inherente a la propuesta narrativa.

«Creo que ha habido una auténtica progresión en los personajes, en la relación y en la posibilidad de ocupar el tiempo en eso. Cada vez hay cosas más emocionantes que podemos hacer. Los guiones que hasta ahora hemos leído son muy descabellados ».

En el reparto también se encuentran Kat Dennings (Darcy en Thor y Thor: Un mundo oscuro ) y Randall Park (Agent Woo en Ant-Man and the Wasp ), actores cómicos que seguramente harán honor a la definición de la serie como «mitad sitcom clásica, mitad espectáculo del MCU» .

WandaVision llegará a Disney+ en la primavera de 2021.
